entities.summary: Luke Glen Richardson is a Canadian professional ice hockey coach and former player. He serves as an assistant coach for the Nashville Predators of the National Hockey League (NHL). He was selected in the first round, seventh overall, by the Toronto Maple Leafs in the 1987 NHL entry draft. Richardson has also played for the Edmonton Oilers, Philadelphia Flyers, Columbus Blue Jackets, Tampa Bay Lightning, and Ottawa Senators.
